subject: POC access takeover — MAP milestone, API keys & peering windows
messages:
From: Claire Thomas <claire.thomas@pharmify.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: it@pharmify.com
Date: 2025-11-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: POC access needs (API keys, org + network)

Irene / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the performance numbers look promising. We want to lock the MAP and get the POC environment scheduled this month. To make sure our security and procurement teams can move fast, can you confirm the rough timeline and owners for the items below?

- Org setup (tenant + admin account)
- API key provisioning for staging/test keys (scoped)
- IP allowlist entries (we’ll provide the firewall CIDRs)
- VPC peering — required ports and expected maintenance window length

Our target: have a usable POC environment for integration testing by week of Nov 24 so we can validate latency and token costs. If that’s doable we’ll push the procurement paperwork next week.

Also, please attach a short MAP spreadsheet (milestones + owners) and any peering req doc so we can share with our infra team.

Claire Thomas
Head of ML Ops, Pharmify
claire.thomas@pharmify.com

Attachments: none
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thomas <claire.thomas@pharmify.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, it@pharmify.com
Date: 2025-11-16T11:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC access needs (API keys, org + network)

Hi Claire — great to hear. We can hit your Nov 24 target with the following proposed cadence. I’ve attached a one-tab MAP + a short peering requirements PDF for the infra team.

High level timeline (commits):
- Nov 16 (today): MAP + owners (this email) — ACTION: Pharmify to confirm allowed CIDRs
- Nov 18: API keys issued (staging) and org admin created — OWNER: Marissa
- Nov 20–21: VPC peering scheduling window; small config changes after test handshake — OWNER: Jonas
- Nov 24: Integration smoke tests begin (Pharmify + Redwood)

Immediate asks from Pharmify:
1) Final list of firewall CIDRs to accept API traffic from (please include egress rules if you have them).
2) A point person for VPC peering (we need an account/project id and a contact for routing validation).

Marissa will provision scoped API keys that limit access to the test tenant; keys will be rotated after the POC. Jonas will own peering and will propose a 30–60 minute maintenance window for the handshake — typically off-hours in your region.

Attachments:
- redwood-map-pharmify-v1.xlsx (MAP: milestones, owners, acceptance criteria)
- vpc-peering-requirements.pdf (necessary ports, route table notes, accepted CIDR sizes)

Thanks — I’ll follow up after Marissa confirms the key names.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thomas <claire.thomas@pharmify.com>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, it@pharmify.com
Date: 2025-11-18T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC access needs (API keys, org + network)

On Mon, Nov 16, 2025 at 9:12 AM Claire Thomas <claire.thomas@pharmify.com> wrote:
> Irene / Redwood team,
>
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the performance numbers look promising. We want to lock the MAP and get the POC environment scheduled this month.

Claire — quick technical note from the provisioning side. I’ve prepared two scoped keys:
- pharmify-test-read (read-only for embeddings / inference sampling)
- pharmify-test-infer (limited generation quota, per-minute rate cap)

I’ll create them in the Pharmify test tenant and paste secure secrets into your preferred secret store once you confirm the secret transfer method (we support Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or a secure DocuSign-styled transfer link).

VPC peering checklist (short):
- Exchange project IDs + VPC names
- Validate overlapping CIDRs (no overlap allowed)
- Agree on route propagation direction and any SNAT requirements
- Test handshake and validate 443 + ephemeral port ranges for our runtime (we include port list in the attached PDF)

Proposed maintenance window for handshake: Nov 20, 23:00–23:45 PST (30–45 minute slot). If that conflicts with your ops calendar let me know two alternatives.

Irene — I will mark these tasks in the MAP sheet under my name and add the key artifact names.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Principal Cloud Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: vpc-peering-requirements.pdf
From: Claire Thomas <claire.thomas@pharmify.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, procure@pharmify.com, it@pharmify.com
Date: 2025-11-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: POC access needs (API keys, org + network)

Thanks everyone — this looks good and we accept the proposed window.

Quick confirmations:
- CIDRs (egress): 198.51.100.0/24, 198.51.101.0/24 (we’ll send a formal permit list to it@pharmify.com)
- VPC point person: Samir Patel (samir.patel@pharmify.com) — Samir is copied on the internal thread and will coordinate the peering handshake
- Procurement: we will issue a short SOW addendum for the POC (procure@pharmify.com) and expect the billing terms to follow the trial pricing table in the MAP sheet

Next steps:
1) Marissa: create keys and deliver secure transfer link by Nov 18 end of day (ACK if done)
2) Jonas: confirm peering start time + routing prep by EOD Nov 19
3) Irene: run smoke test report template once handshake is complete and post findings to the Drive link

We’ll aim to start integration tests Nov 24. If anything slips, I’ll flag it and request a 24–48 hour wiggle.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Claire

Claire Thomas
Head of ML Ops, Pharmify
claire.thomas@pharmify.com

Forwarded attachments: redwood-map-pharmify-v1.xlsx, vpc-peering-requirements.pdf
